claims.quote: Haifa sold 412 thousand cups in 2024, up from 350 thousand in 2022, an increase of 25%.
claims.sql: SELECT 100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN cups_sold_k END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN cups_sold_k END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN cups_sold_k END) FROM cafes WHERE city = 'Haifa'

claims.quote: Haifa's revenue reached 1,480 thousand USD in 2024.
claims.sql: SELECT revenue_k_usd FROM cafes WHERE city = 'Haifa' AND year = 2024

claims.quote: Tel Aviv sold 610 thousand cups in 2024, more than any other city.
claims.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cups_sold_k FROM cafes WHERE city = 'Tel Aviv' AND year = 2024) = (SELECT MAX(cups_sold_k) FROM cafes WHERE year = 2024) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cups_sold_k) FROM cafes WHERE year = 2024 AND cups_sold_k >= (SELECT cups_sold_k FROM cafes WHERE city = 'Tel Aviv' AND year = 2024)) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT cups_sold_k FROM cafes WHERE city = 'Jerusalem' AND year = 2024
